title: Panel: Battery Demand & Commodities Update
gist: Member-only listing for a 17-minute Benchmark Summit 2026 London panel (Oct 22) that opens with Benchmark's battery demand outlook and then gives analyst updates on cobalt, nickel, lithium, graphite and copper. Only the session description and the four Benchmark speakers are given, with no forecasts or prices.

themes.theme: Session structure: demand first, then commodities

insights.claim: Benchmark's Battery Demand & Commodities Update session opened with Benchmark's battery demand outlook and then moved to commodity-specific updates on cobalt, nickel, lithium, graphite and copper, followed by a shared audience Q&A.
insights.speaker: Zoe Zhang , Senior Analyst - EV & Battery , Benchmark Mineral Intelligence; Adam Webb , Head of Energy Raw Materials , B
insights.so_what: Benchmark anchors its views on each raw material in a single battery demand outlook, so revisions to that outlook spread to every commodity view.
